styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Rock Hall, the art museum and Playhouse Square.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: West Side Market, pierogi and lake perch.

styles.label: Family
styles.blurb: Science center, zoo and lakefront parks.

stays.why: Walk to Rock Hall, the Flats and Playhouse Square. Best base without a car.
Next to West Side Market and the brewery strip; short Rapid or bus ride downtown.
Museums, Severance Hall and Case Western on the doorstep; Health Line to downtown.
Quiet streets, galleries and cafés; a short walk or ride over the river to downtown.

food: Try Cleveland classics: a Polish boy sandwich, pierogi, and lake perch or walleye.
West Side Market in Ohio City: graze the stalls for sausages, cheese and pastries. Check opening days before you go.
Little Italy on Mayfield Road near University Circle: pasta, pizza and espresso after the museums.
Cheap eats: diners and corner taverns downtown and in Tremont, roughly $10–20 a meal.
Book ahead for popular weekend brunch spots and for dinner on game nights downtown.
more_time: Swap a downtown afternoon for the Cleveland Metroparks Zoo or the Lake Metroparks Farmpark if you have kids.
Add a half-day at the Cleveland Museum of Art and the adjoining Wade Oval museums in University Circle.
In summer, swap a city day for a Lake Erie beach or a drive along the lake to nearby towns.

recommend.why: Two nights covers Rock Hall, the museums and the West Side Market without rushing; add a night in summer for the lakefront.

month_notes: January: cold, highs near 2°C and lows around -4°C. About 15 wet days; pack a warm coat.
February: still cold, highs near 3°C. Slightly fewer wet days, around 12.
March: cool and changeable, highs near 7°C with lows near -1°C. Keep a rain layer.
April: mild but wet, highs near 13°C and about 16 rain days. Bring an umbrella.
May: pleasant, highs near 19°C. Good month for walking and parks.
June: warm, highs near 24°C. Comfortable days, some rain.
July: warmest, highs near 26°C and lows near 20°C. Book hotels early.
August: warm and humid, highs near 26°C. Similar to July; good for the lakefront.
September: mild and drier, highs near 23°C with about 10 rain days. A strong month to visit.
October: cool and often wet, highs near 17°C with about 14 rain days.
November: chilly, highs near 10°C. Bring layers and a rain jacket.
December: cold, highs near 5°C and lows near 0°C. About 15 wet days; expect grey skies.

climate_guide.summary: Humid continental climate: cold, grey winters and warm, pleasant summers. Rain is spread through the year.

items.title: Best time: June to September
items.text: Highs around 23–26°C and lows near 16–20°C. Best for walking, parks and the lakefront.

items.title: Winter is cold (December to February)
items.text: Highs near 2–5°C and lows around -4°C. Dress in warm layers and plan indoor sights.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 10–16 wet days every month. April is the wettest; September the driest.

items.title: Spring and autumn are mild
items.text: Highs near 13–19°C in spring and 10–17°C in autumn. Changeable, so pack layers.

items.title: Lake-effect weather
items.text: Winds off Lake Erie can bring sudden cold and snow in winter. Check the forecast on the day.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: A waterproof jacket and umbrella any month; warm coat, hat and gloves for winter; light layers for summer.

transit.best: RTA Rapid trains and buses for most trips; walk downtown; ride apps for late nights.

modes.text: RTA Rapid rail: the Red Line links the airport to downtown. Blue and Green Lines serve the east side. The Waterfront Line tram connects Tower City to the Flats, stadium and Rock Hall.
RTA buses cover the city. The Health Line BRT runs Euclid Avenue from downtown to University Circle. An all-day RTA pass costs about $5 and covers buses and trains.
Taxis are metered. Uber and Lyft both operate widely.
Driving is easy with grid streets and light traffic. Downtown has purple district signs.
Walking works well downtown. Bike trails and paths are expanding.
